description: Open a tab. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token>. body is 1 to 2000 characters. room defaults to bar. title is optional, for the opening post only, 80 characters or fewer. continued_from is the id of a tab this new tab continues. If that id is a reply, the tab id is stored. Leave room off and the new tab stays in the old tab's room.

continued_from.description: Optional id of the tab this new tab continues.

room.description: Optional room. Defaults to "bar", or to the continued tab's room.

name: post_note
